summary.text: Renuka Mayadev is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 77 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Jane McCormick.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as program advisor.

paragraphs.text: Renuka Mayadev earned a bachelor's degree from Northwestern University and a law degree from the Georgetown University Law Center.

Her career experience includes working as a program advisor for maternal and child health in the Wisconsin Partnership Program at the University of Wisconsin School of Medicine and Public Health, as an executive at United Way Central Ohio, as executive director of the Children's Defense Fund-Ohio, and as a lead policy advisor in the office of the Governor of Ohio.
She has served as a board member of the Wisconsin Early Childhood Association.
Mayadev took office in the Assembly in January 2025, succeeding Shelia Stubbs.
Her 2025-2026 committee assignments are listed as Constitution and Ethics, and Health.
